engagement.title: Engagement Rate Calculator
engagement.desc: Calculate the engagement rate of Instagram, TikTok or YouTube accounts. Ideal for influencer selection and performance analysis.
engagement.cardDesc: Enter the values for an average post
engagement.industryAvg: Industry average is 1–3%. Above 3% is good, above 6% is excellent.
engagement.infoParagraph1: Engagement rate is a metric that shows how actively a social media account interacts with its followers. It is calculated by dividing the sum of likes, comments and shares by the follower count.
engagement.infoParagraph2: A high follower count does not always mean high engagement. In brand partnerships and influencer marketing campaigns, the engagement rate is a more valuable metric than follower count.

hashtag.title: Instagram Hashtag Generator
hashtag.desc: Automatically generate hashtags by category to help your posts reach more people.
hashtag.cardDesc: Enter a keyword and select a category
hashtag.infoParagraph1: Using the right hashtags on Instagram significantly increases the chance of your posts appearing on the Explore page. Research shows that posts using at least 11 hashtags receive 79% more engagement.
hashtag.infoParagraph2: Select the category that matches your post, enter an optional keyword, and click "Generate Hashtags". Copy the generated hashtags with one click and paste them into your Instagram post.

font.title: Instagram Font Generator
font.desc: Create unique font styles for your bio and posts. Use with copy-paste.
font.cardDesc: Every style updates in real time
font.infoTitle1: How to Use Custom Fonts on Instagram?
font.infoParagraph1: Instagram does not support standard text formatting, but you can achieve different font styles using Unicode characters. The tool above automatically converts your text to Unicode characters. Copy your favourite style and paste it into your bio or post.

planner.title: Post Planner
planner.desc: Select your platform and see the best engagement times for each day. Based on Turkey time (UTC+3).
planner.cardDesc: Recommended posting times based on research
planner.infoParagraph1: Engagement in the first few minutes is critical in social media algorithms. By posting when your audience is most active, you can significantly increase your organic reach.
planner.infoTitle2: Where Does This Data Come From?
planner.infoParagraph2: Posting times are based on global and Turkey-focused research data from various social media analytics platforms (Sprout Social, Hootsuite, Later). Actual results may vary by account type and audience.

character.title: Character & Word Counter
character.desc: Prepare your social media posts within platform limits. Real-time character, word and line count.
character.cardDesc: Results update in real time as you type
character.infoParagraph1: Each social media platform has different character limits. Text above the limit is cut off or cannot be posted. With this tool you can check your text in advance and prepare content suitable for all platforms.
